mentions.name: unobin
mentions.description: A tool that compiles infrastructure-as-code (IaC) into a single binary with all dependencies included. It provides standardized CLI options, autogenerated configs, and optional in-browser visualization, following a more Terraform-like model after an earlier Ansible-playbook-to-binary proof of concept.
mentions.problem: Working with IaC tooling like Terraform leaves pain points around dependencies, CLI conventions, and config management, which motivated compiling infrastructure code into a self-contained binary.
mentions.source_excerpt: My original idea for this was to compile an Ansible-like playbook to a binary. I made a POC for it around 2020, and then it sat on the shelf. More recently I picked it up again following a more Terraform-like model. It compiles IaC to a binary with all dependencies included, standardized CLI options, autogenerated configs, optional visualization in the browser, and lots of other features.
